activity_summary: Heminges named the share at thirty-four shillings, against thirty-eight last Saturday, and did not open the coffer. You gave no total. Bryan said the court went down to Greenwich today, with my lord and Kettleby, and that he had it from the household. You said there is no summons before Michaelmas. The licensed book is out, and not a loss. Monday is Errors, and you took no roll. You are enclosing nothing to Edmund.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Named thirty-four, refused a total, and stopped the bill at Monday.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the share back, with no balance and no enclosure.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Took the share as the thing that spends, and kept Stratford off it.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Took thirty-four on a real Saturday, and did not bring a cake.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Brought Greenwich, my lord, and Kettleby, from the household.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Heard the door shut on a summons, and kept the later entrance.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Left the rest of the week unset.

entities.name: Ambrose Kettleby
entities.context: Was named as gone with the court, and was not in the room.

entities.name: Henry Carey, 1st Lord Hunsdon
entities.context: Was my lord, gone with the court, and was not in the room.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Thirty-four is received. It is not a balance.

quotes.speaker: george_bryan
quotes.text: The court went down to Greenwich today.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Thirty-four shillings. Received. Not a balance.
